description: Read one customer's summary: lifetime revenue and the last 30 and 90 days, outstanding and overdue invoices, payments collected, credit left, costs and margin, orders, contacts, last activity, a 90-day usage trend, the agents linked to them, and a health status with the reasons behind it. Answers 404 (not released) until the customer Overview and Intel release is on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_customer_overview
